title: Concrete raw presentation of the étale derived tensor
statement: For a monoidal Grothendieck abelian coefficient category B with functorial flat resolutions and a scheme X, the derived étale tensor functor is equal to the curried tensor of the derived monoidal structure induced by the quasi-isomorphism localization.

proof.text: Unfold derivedTensor and identify its localization functor and quasi-isomorphism property with the displayed raw curried tensor.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleTensorRaw (B : Type c) [Category.{u + 1} B] [Abelian B]
    [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{u + 1} B] [MonoidalCategory B]
    [MonoidalPreadditive B] [SymmetricCategory B] [MonoidalClosed B]
    [Abelian.HasFunctorialFlatResolution B]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) : derivedTensor B X =
      @curriedTensor _ _ (DerivedMonoidal.instMonoidalCategory _root_.DerivedCategory.Qh
        (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology B) (.up ℤ)))
